information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6OTc4NzUsInB1ciI6ImJsb2JfaWQifX0=--6df7380aacd9d1e01769c55068b6070ad1efe100/CCSP2025%20text-01.png) This competition is an integral part of the “Cube Camp” series, organized by ThailandCube. The third edition of “Cube Camp” will be held in Suan Pheung, Ratchaburi, this year. “Cube Camp” is a three-day competition that features all World Cube Association (WCA) events, making this an opportunity for every categories you are into! The competition will be held in a venue that provides food and night accommodations, ensuring a comfortable stay for participants. **The 2,500 THB registration fees includes: Competition Fees 2 nights accommodation (9 and 10 August) 2 breakfasts (10 and 11 August) 2 lunches (10 and 11 August) and 2 dinners (9 and 10 August)** If you have any companions and want to reserve more room, please contact us, this will cost 2,300 THB per guest. Please see in tabs for more information.
